subject: Biology
title: Cell Cycle and Cell Division
summary: Cell cycle = ek cell ka bada hona, DNA copy karna aur do mein batna. Interphase (G1 → S → G2) poore cycle ka 95% se zyada time leta hai; asli division (M phase) chhota hota hai.
S phase mein DNA double hota hai (2C → 4C), lekin chromosome number same rehta hai, kyunki har chromosome mein ab do sister chromatids hain.
Mitosis (equational division): 2n → 2n, do identical cells — growth, repair. Meiosis (reductional division): 2n → n, chaar cells — gametes, aur crossing over se variation.
Exam ka core: mitosis ke stages ke markers, prophase I ke 5 sub-stages, aur har stage par chromosome number + DNA content.

formulas.name: DNA content
formulas.formula: G1: 2C → S ke baad / G2: 4C → meiosis I ke baad: 2C → meiosis II ke baad: C
formulas.when: Kisi bhi stage ka DNA nikalna.
formulas.mistake: Chromosome number sirf meiosis I mein aadha hota hai, S phase mein nahi badalta.

formulas.name: Cells and divisions
formulas.formula: k rounds ke baad cells = 2ᵏ;   N cells banane ke liye mitotic divisions = N − 1
formulas.mistake: 128 cells ke liye 7 generations lagti hain, par divisions 127.

examples.title: Har stage ki ginti
examples.problem: Ek cell mein 2n = 16, G1 mein DNA = 2C. G2, meiosis I ke baad aur meiosis II ke baad?
examples.solution: G2: 16 chromosomes, 4C. Meiosis I ke baad (har cell): 8 chromosomes (har ek mein 2 chromatids), 2C. Meiosis II ke baad: 8 chromosomes, C.

examples.title: 128 cells
examples.problem: Ek cell se 128 cells banane ke liye kitni mitotic divisions?

examples.title: Stage pehchano
examples.problem: (a) Chromosomes equator par, spindle fibres kinetochores se jude. (b) Sister chromatids poles ki taraf ja rahe hain.
examples.solution: (a) Metaphase. (b) Anaphase — centromere split hokar chromatids alag hote hain.

topics.title: Interphase
topics.explain: G1: cell metabolically active, badhta hai. S: DNA replication; animal cells mein centriole bhi duplicate. G2: proteins ban-te hain, mitosis ki taiyari. Divide na karne wale cells G0 (quiescent) mein chale jaate hain.

topics.title: Mitosis ke stages
topics.explain: Prophase: chromatin condense, spindle shuru. Metaphase: chromosomes metaphase plate par — morphology study ke liye best. Anaphase: centromere split, chromatids poles ki taraf. Telophase: nuclear envelope wapas, chromosomes decondense.

topics.title: Cytokinesis
topics.explain: Animal cell: membrane mein furrow ban-ta hai jo andar ki taraf gehra hota hai. Plant cell: rigid wall ki wajah se beech mein cell plate ban-ti hai jo bahar ki taraf badhti hai.

topics.title: Prophase I
topics.explain: Leptotene (chromosomes dikhne lagte hain) → Zygotene (synapsis, synaptonemal complex) → Pachytene (crossing over) → Diplotene (chiasmata dikhte hain) → Diakinesis (chiasmata terminalise).

topics.title: Significance
topics.explain: Mitosis: growth, repair, genetic stability. Meiosis: har generation mein chromosome number constant rakhta hai aur variation laata hai — evolution ka raw material.

ratta: Prophase I mnemonic: "Lazy Zebra Plays Dirty Dance" = Leptotene, Zygotene, Pachytene, Diplotene, Diakinesis.
Human cell in culture ~24 h per cycle; yeast ~90 min.
